title: 156. Design HashSet

examples.explanation: After add(1) and add(2), contains(1) is 1 and contains(3) is 0. After add(2) again, contains(2) is 1. After remove(2), contains(2) is 0.
Initially contains(5) is 0. After add(5), contains(5) is 1. After remove(5), contains(5) is 0.
No contains calls, so the result is empty.

hints: Simulate the set with a hash set: add inserts, remove deletes, contains checks membership and records 1 or 0.
A boolean array of size 1000001 also works since keys are bounded, giving O(1) operations.
